description: Keysmith claim chains: presentations a gating provider must serve or refuse. Every case is the output of verifyPresentation() from @filoz/keysmith; other implementations can check themselves against this file. Keys are the public Anvil development keys. Byte strings are 0x-prefixed lowercase hex; integers too large for JSON are decimal strings.

types.ReadGrant: ReadGrant(uint8 v,string node,address owner,bytes16 keyspace,address bearer,uint8 maxDepth,uint256 chainId,bytes16 keyCommitment,bytes16 keyspaceCommitment,uint64 expires)
